[Egg Salesman]
^FF0000Chicken Eggs^000000! Come and
buy as many Chicken Eggs
as you want, whenever you
want! Hey buddy, you wanna
take a look at the Chicken
Eggs that I'm selling?
What are you doing?
Why Chicken Eggs?
Sure, I'll buy some.
Never mind.

[Egg Salesman]
What am I--? I'm
selling Chicken Eggs!
For this special event
period, I'm selling as many
Chicken Eggs as you could
want for only 500 zeny each!

[Egg Salesman]
Boys, girls, friends,
family, old people, young
people, um, maybe not most
vegetarians or raw foodists,
but almost everyone likes eggs!

[Egg Salesman]
Can you imagine a world
without eggs? There'd be
no bread, pastries, cake
or frosting... Ice cream
would be a lot runnier...
Pranks wouldn't be as fun...

[Egg Salesman]
I'm not really sure why, but
Chicken Eggs are popular
around this time of year.
They're hot items right
now, and I aim to cash in!

[Egg Salesman]
Great! How many do you
want? Remember that each
Chicken Egg is 500 zeny.
Remember that you won't
always be able to buy
Chicken Eggs so easily!

[Egg Salesman]
Hey, if you're not
going to buy anything,
then would you mind getting
out of the way so I can
help out my customers?

[Egg Salesman]
Hey, you mind giving
me a real number? I also
can't sell you more than
1,000 Chicken Eggs at a time,
you know. C'mon, tell me how
many you want for real now.

[Egg Salesman]
You don't have enough Zeny.

[Egg Salesman]
No discount, go and get enough Zeny.

[Egg Salesman]
Hey, I know you really
want to buy some Chicken
Eggs, but you won't be able
to carry that much now. Why
don't you free up some
Inventory space first?.

[Egg Salesman]
Here's your Chicken Eggs!
I guess there's some festival
happening where you'll need
them, but I don't know anything
about that. Well, have a good
time, and I'll see you again!

[Egg Salesman]
Not interested in buying
Chicken Eggs, huh? Well,
word's going around that
there's some kind of festival
where they'll come in handy...
Can you really pass this up?

[Dowdy Matron]
This festival is going
to be so much fun! Ooh!
I should buy some Chicken
Eggs to make some decorations.

[Dowdy Matron]
Speaking of which,
I've heard the nun that
can make Holy Eggs is back
in Prontera. Though, I think
she's using Chicken Eggs rather
than regular Eggs to make them.

[Cantankerous Geezer]
.Hey, do you know how
Chicken Eggs got to be so
expensive? I mean, 500 zeny
is a lot! I think it's because
some guy in Morocc is trying
to amass a ton of Holy Eggs!

[Cantankerous Geezer]
I don't know what he's
offering for those Holy
Eggs, but adventurers are
coming to him with Holy Eggs
in droves. I wonder what he's
giving to them in return?

[Nerlen]
Hello! If you'd like,
I can take your Chicken
Eggs and transform them
into Holy Eggs. It's something
I do for others in celebration
of this holy season.

[Nerlen]
Holy Eggs represent
rebirth and, fittingly,
can be used to restore
life to your friends.
Would you like me to
make some for you?
What do I need to make Holy Eggs?
I want to make Holy Eggs.
Maybe next time.

[Nerlen]
For each Holy Egg
that you want me to
make, you will need
to bring me...

[Nerlen]
^4D4DFF1 White Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Green Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Yellow Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Holy Water^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Chicken Egg^000000.

[Nerlen]
Alright, how many
Holy Eggs would you
like me to make you?
I can only make up to
10 Holy Eggs at a time.
Enter ''0'' to cancel.

[Nerlen]
Oh, you changed your
mind? Feel free to visit me
whenever you want me to
make you some Holy Eggs~

[Nerlen]
I'm sorry, but I can only
make up to 10 Holy Eggs
at a time. If you wanted to
cancel, then just enter ''0.''

[Nerlen]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough items to make
Holy Eggs. You need the
following for me to create
each Holy Egg for you.

[Nerlen]
^4D4DFF1 White Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Green Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Yellow Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Holy Water^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Chicken Egg^000000.

[Nerlen]
I'm sorry, but you
won't be able to carry
that many Holy Eggs now...
You'd better free up more
space in your Inventory first.

[Nerlen]
Thank you!
I hope you enjoy
these Holy Eggs~
Hope you to be with God's love.

[Nerlen]
Alright, I understand.
May God bless you.

[Corps Member]
How are you doing?
Death... It's inescapable.
Even you'll die someday. But...

[Corps Member]
Oh, yes. That's it.
You have it. The egg you
hold has a secret power.
I think that... Yes. Someone
like you would understand
us, fit well into our group.

[Corps Member]
Why don't
you... Join us?
What for?
Um... But you're suspicious!

[Corps Member]
I see I've caught your
interest! Well, if you'd
like to join us and learn
more, then why don't you
bring me 10 Holy Eggs?
That is my condition.

[Corps Member]
Really? Well, I suppose
I can't help it. Let me
assure you that our
organization works
for the greater good.

[Corps Member]
We should all enjoy
life while we still can.
Who knows? Perhaps
there will be other lives
to live after this one.
Perhaps, perhaps....

[Corps Member]
Ah, you have returned.
Did you still wish to
join our ranks? If so,
I hope you brought the
10 Holy Eggs I require.
Give Holy Eggs
Don't Give Holy Eggs

[Corps Member]
So you do wish to
join our organization.
First, let me check if you
brought the Holy Eggs...

[Corps Member]
Very well. In return
for these Holy Eggs, let
me give you a small present
for joining us. Now, I can
tell you about what we do.

[Corps Member]
^333333*Cough Cough*^000000
Excuse me, I've got--
^333333*Cough!*^000000 A... A bit of a
sore throat. Give me a sec...

[Corps Member]
Hm. You don't have enough
Holy Eggs to meet the condition
I set for you. Did you leave
them in your Storage?

[Corps Member]
Hm? I suppose I can't
blame you for being a bit
suspicious of us. Let me
assure you that ours is
a mission of holiness.

[Corps Member]
We are an organization
that is dedicated to...
Resurrecting dead heroes!

[Corps Member]
Those Holy Eggs that you've
brought have the power to
restore life to the dead.
In large quantities...
They can even revive
ancient fallen heroes!

[Corps Member]
When you bring me
33 Holy Eggs, I will
enchant them so that you
can use them on areas where
ancient heroes had died.

[Corps Member]
Go and bring me
33 Holy Eggs! I shall be
waiting here for your return...

[Corps Member]
Ah, you've returned
Now, did you bring me
33 Holy Eggs for your task?
Give Holy Eggs
Don't Give Holy Eggs

[Corps Member]
Ah, these will do!
Now, make a note of the
destination I describe as
I infuse these Holy Eggs
with additional magic.

[Corps Member]
You must go to the
entrance of Payon Dungeon,
where a nimble hero has fallen.
Sacrifice the Holy Eggs there,
and then return to me. Now...
Go, and bring him back to life!

[Corps Member]
Go to the 3rd level of
Izlude dungeon... A hero.
that sought wisdom perished
at the entrance to the 4th
level. Sacrifice the Holy Eggs
there, and return him to life!

[Corps Member]
Go to the abandoned mine
dungeon where a brave hero
died to protect his comrades.
Sacrifice the Holy Eggs as soon
as you get to the 3rd floor.
Go, and bring him back to life!

[Corps Member]
Go to Glastheim, and
sacrifice the Holy Eggs
as soon as you enter the
2nd floor. A hero perished
there, but you shall bring
him back to the living!

[Corps Member]
Hm? This isn't
33 Holy Eggs. Did you
leave some in your Storage?

[Corps Member]
Don't you understand
the righteousness of
our cause? Returning fallen
heroes will bring peace to
our lands much more quickly!

[Corps Member]
Did you forget
where you must go?
Let me remind you
so that you do not
lose your way...
[Corps Member]

[Corps Member]
You must go to the
entrance of Payon Dungeon,
where a nimble hero has fallen.
Sacrifice the Holy Eggs there,
and then return to me. Now...
Go, and bring him back to life!

[Corps Member]
Go to the 3rd level of
Izlude dungeon... A hero.

there, and return him to life!

[Corps Member]
Go to the abandoned mine
dungeon where a brave hero
died to protect his comrades.
Sacrifice the Holy Eggs as soon
as you get to the 3rd floor.
Go, and bring him back to life!

Go to Glastheim, and
sacrifice the Holy Eggs
as soon as you enter the
2nd floor. A hero perished
there, but you shall bring
him back to the living!

[Corps Member]
Ah, I hope you've come
back with good news.
So did it work?

[{0}]
Actually...
Nothing happened....

[Corps Member]
What? It can't be.
The magic... It should
have been powerful enough...
Well, it's too bad that we
failed. Even so, I am grateful
for all your help thus far...

[Corps Member]
We'll investigate what
could have gone wrong,
and then try again next year.
Farewell, my friend, and I hope
that you'll assist us again.

[Corps Member]
Shh! Tell no one
that I am here.

[{0}]

This is the place
the Corps Member
wanted me to find...
Time to use all of
these Holy Eggs.

[{0}]

Will this really bring
this ancient hero
back to life? I'm...
I'm kind of scared!

[{0}]

[{0}]
